summary: No operator website, no booking engine and no posted rate anywhere: only a Facebook page, directory listings (Travel Wisconsin, WACO, RoverPass unclaimed, RV Life) and a Google listing with 2 reviews. Imagery shows ~60+ set-up RVs, far beyond the 25 sites the directories list - looks mostly seasonal. Drop candidate on presence. Cleared directory-only hookups/season/booking. Pin ~360 m off.
